CVE-2024-7598 affects Kubernetes API server behavior around node status updates and does not apply to the Node Feature Discovery binaries shipped in this image. NFD consumes Kubernetes client and API types but does not run kube-apiserver or the affected admission/status update path.

CVE-2025-1767 affects Kubernetes clusters that use the deprecated in-tree gitRepo volume plugin. The Node Feature Discovery binaries shipped in this image are not kubelet or kube-apiserver components and do not process pod volumes, so the vulnerable gitRepo volume execution path is not present in this image's runtime behavior.

CVE-2024-7598 concerns namespace deletion ordering, where pods could outlive their NetworkPolicies during namespace termination. The Kubernetes 1.33+ sources used for these kube-apiserver packages include OrderedNamespaceDeletion enabled by default, and the namespace deletion implementation deletes pods before other namespaced resources when that gate is enabled.
